inputs.xtext_rule_text:
Conjugation returns SysML::Conjugation :
	( 'conjugation' Identification? )?
    'conjugate' 
    ( conjugatedType = [SysML::Type | QualifiedName]
	| ownedRelatedElement += OwnedFeatureChain )
    ( '~' | 'conjugates') 
    ( originalType = [SysML::Type | QualifiedName]
	| ownedRelatedElement += OwnedFeatureChain )
	RelationshipBody
;

decision: KerML 8.2.4.1.3 states Conjugation = ( 'conjugation' Identification )? 'conjugate' ( conjugatedType = [QualifiedName] | conjugatedType = FeatureChain ) CONJUGATES ( originalType = [QualifiedName] | originalType = FeatureChain ) RelationshipBody. The KerML Xtext writes `Identification?` inside the optional group and OwnedFeatureChain where the clause writes FeatureChain; neither is taken over, since the clause's own reference is FeatureChain. CONJUGATES is the special lexical terminal of KerML 8.2.2.7, '~' | 'conjugates'. The `{ ownedRelatedElement += ... }` actions are abstract syntax, not syntax. The rule is the clause as written.
